slices.title: Durable send receipts
slices.summary: Gives each sent or queued message an identity the transcript can dedupe on: AppendMessageRequest.client_message_id = 18, AppendMessageResponse message_id = 2 and deduplicated = 3, a unique (thread_id, client_message_id) index, and a lookup in append_message_in_tx before the insert. Queued input persists before it is enqueued (closes D3), and the SPA tray reports delivered, not delivered, or resent. Behind MODEL_GATEWAY_SEND_RECEIPTS (default off).
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/rust' && cargo test -q -p mp-events -p mp-contracts --all-targets

cd 'apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3' && pnpm vitest run src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/features/chat/components/mid-run-input.test.ts src/features/chat/components/use-chat-controller.send-receipts.test.ts
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_SEND_RECEIPTS (default off; the SPA sends client_message_id regardless of the flag, and omits it for ZDR)

decisions_defaults.DEC-07: (a) NATS request/reply to owner, no message content stored; local hit wins, bus error = 503 `run_control_unavailable` (retryable), never fake 202/404; `/readyz` reports `run_control`. Keep code order (enqueue first) through S3, record ledger correction; reorde

slices.notes: Dependency notes: WS17 resolved to WS17-S1
